summary:
Implementation plan for TermBlitz Advanced Super-Resolution and Dithering Pipeline Upgrades:
- Multi-pass recursive chaining for 4x/8x deep-zoom scaling with reusable scratch buffers.
- Fast adaptive JPEG 8x8 DCT block artifact removal and edge-preserving bilateral denoising filter.
- Content-aware pixel art and vector graphics detector with pure Rust Scale2x / AdvMame2x engine, CLI flag (--pixel-art), and p hotkey.
- Comprehensive unit test suite in src/upscale.rs.
